project.title: Eukaryotic community in atmospheric environment
project.description: Eukaryotic community in 286 aerosol samples was monitored using MiSeq sequencing. A total number of 286 samples were collected regularly over 3 years (from April 10th, 2019 to May 14th, 2022) in Busan, Korea.
project.center_name: Environmental Microbiology  Microbiology, Pusan National University
